title: Boundary Record
governance_note: Urban congestion conclusions are not meaningful without a defined boundary and spillover context.

title: Flow Record
governance_note: Vehicle flow should not be treated as the only mobility outcome.

title: Capacity Record
governance_note: Capacity depends on design, operations, behavior, incidents, and curb use.

title: Behavior Record
governance_note: Fixed-demand assumptions can mislead in long-run planning.

title: Multimodal Record
governance_note: Ignoring non-auto modes can distort congestion and equity interpretation.

title: Equity Record
governance_note: Average travel-time improvements can hide unequal burden or local harm.

title: Claim Boundary
governance_note: Urban conclusions should not exceed boundary definitions, data evidence, behavioral assumptions, uncertainty, equity review, and tested scope.
